headline: DraftKings Shares Slide 26% on Prediction Market Concerns
summary: DraftKings stock dropped more than 26% on Friday as analysts raised concerns regarding regulation and competition surrounding its entry into prediction markets.
why: Regulatory scrutiny and competitive pressures in emerging betting segments can significantly impact growth valuations for online wagering platforms.
